title: Diagram library coverage
summary: The comparison, sequence, marker, note, Mermaid sequence and Before panel slices shipped in stack #376. Inspected at c607e0e with no uncommitted changes.
reason: Byron chose diagram quality as the lead job, then asked for all the work and a merge when CI passed.
follow_ups: Keep one CSV set: docs/research or assets/pro-results.
Close PR 116 if its semantic signature idea is covered.
Close or rebase PR 331; M2 to M4 stay open there.
A crossing halo can cut a short marked line.
An old label taller than its new one can crowd its row in a Before panel.

writeArrangement can still write stay hints from a layout pass.
# still starts a comment inside a bare word, so an unquoted URL fragment is lost.
